scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace uiux-base-app-kit && npm run build --workspace uiux-base && npm run build --workspace @uiux-base/config
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace starter && npm run build --workspace demo
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck && npm run test:workspaces && npm run build:apps && npm run check:package
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish --workspace uiux-base-app-kit --access public && npm publish --workspace uiux-base --access public
